name: nested_rule
rule:
  variables:
  - name: "permitted_regions"
    expression: "['us', 'uk', 'es']"
  match:
  - condition: resource.origin in variables.permitted_regions
    output: "false"
  - output: "{'banned': true}"

name: "errors_compose_conflicting_output"
description: "Tests for conflicting outputs in policy compilation"
sections:
- name: "compile"
  tests:
  - name: "incompatible_output_types"
    output:
      error_set:
      - "incompatible output types: block has output type map(string, bool), but previous outputs have type bool"

value.description: Tests for conflicting outputs in policy compilation
value.name: errors_compose_conflicting_output

error_set: incompatible output types: block has output type map(string, bool), but previous outputs have type bool
